content: The images referenced are sourced from various reputable and specialized medical and public health image libraries. These include the National Library of Medicine's MedPix and Open-i platforms, as well as Wikimedia Commons. Additionally, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) provides access to its Public Health Image Library (PHIL), which serves as an organized and universal electronic gateway to the CDC's extensive collection of images. The CDC's Division of Parasitic Diseases and Malaria (DPDM) also contributes through its DPDx initiative, which focuses on the laboratory identification of parasitic diseases that are of public health significance. Furthermore, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) maintains its own image libraries, which are curated for medical and scientific use.
